Signing In & Account Roles

Section 1

👑 Owner

  • Full access to all features
  • Manage staff, products, wallet
  • View all reports and history
  • Billing and plan management

🧑‍💼 Cashier

  • Take orders at the register
  • Cash and credit sales
  • View own wallet balance
  • No access to owner settings

📋 Manager

  • Record bar expenses
  • View items and customers
  • Access machines tracker
  • No billing or staff management
1

Go to the app URL

Open Bartendaz Pro in your browser or via the installed APK.

2

Enter your username and password

Owners register an account first. Cashiers and managers are created by the owner inside the app.

3

You'll land on your role's home screen

Owners go to the Bar register. Cashiers go to the register. Managers go to Items.

💡

Forgot your password? Use the Forgot Password link on the login page to reset via email.

🕐

Opening & Closing the Bar Session

Section 2

Each day starts with opening the session and ends with closing it. Cashier wallets are tracked per session.

1

Open the Bar tab

Tap Bar in the menu. If no session is open you'll see the Open Session button.

2

Start selling

Once open, cashiers can take orders immediately. All sales are logged in real time.

3

Close the session (owner)

At end of day the owner closes the session from the Wallet page. This locks the session totals.

🍺

Bar (POS) — Taking Orders

Section 3
1

Tap items to add to cart

Browse by category tabs at the top. Tap any product to add one unit to the cart.

2

Adjust quantities

Long-press an item in the cart to change its quantity or remove it.

3

Choose cash or credit

Tap Cash Sale or Credit Sale to proceed to checkout.

💡

Sort items by tapping the sort icon (⇅) at the top right of the product grid. Tap an item then tap another to swap positions.

💵

Cash Sales & Change

Section 4
1

Tap Cash Sale

After building the order, tap the Cash Sale button at the bottom of the cart.

2

Enter amount tendered

Type in the amount the customer gives you. The app calculates change instantly.

3

Confirm the sale

Tap Confirm. The sale is recorded and the cashier wallet is updated.

💳

Credit Sales (Charge to Tab)

Section 5
1

Tap Credit Sale

Select Credit Sale from the cart. You'll be prompted to choose a customer.

2

Select or create a customer

Search existing credit accounts or tap + New Account to create one on the spot.

3

Confirm charge

The amount is added to that customer's outstanding balance. No cash changes hands.

💡

Customers can pay off their tab later from the Customers section. Tap a customer then Add Payment.

🥃

Opened Bottles & Drink Sales

Section 6

Sell individual shots from an opened bottle of liquor without reducing stock on the full-bottle product.

1

Tap the 🥃 bottle icon

On the Bar screen, tap the Shot from Bottle button to open the bottle selector.

2

Choose a liquor product

Select the open bottle. The shot price is set per product in your Items catalog.

3

Add to order

Tap Add Shot. It appears in the cart like any other item and can be sold as cash or credit.

🚬

Cigarette & Rolling Paper Packs

Section 7

Sell individual cigarettes or papers from an open pack without tracking as a full-unit sale.

1

Tap the 🚬 cigarette icon

This opens the retail cigarette/paper selector on the Bar screen.

2

Select the product and quantity

Choose which pack is open and how many singles to sell.

3

Add to order and complete sale

Items appear in the cart and go through the normal cash/credit checkout.

🎁

Specials & Bundle Deals

Section 8

Create deals that combine multiple products at a single bundle price — e.g. "Rum & Coke $25".

1

Go to Specials

Owners tap Specials in the menu to manage deals.

2

Create a new special

Name the deal, set the bundle price, and add the products it includes.

3

Cashiers sell specials from the Bar

Specials appear in the product grid and are added to the cart like any item.

📦

Items (Product Catalog)

Section 9
1

Tap Items in the menu

Only owners and managers can access this section.

2

Add or edit a product

Set the name, category, selling price, cost price, and stock level. Optionally add a photo.

3

Stock is tracked automatically

Every confirmed sale deducts from stock. You'll see a low-stock indicator when levels drop.

💡

Set a cost price to see your profit margin per product in the Summary report.

💰

Wallet & Financial Overview

Section 10

Every owner and cashier has a wallet. Cash sales go to the cashier's wallet. Owners can transfer funds to their own wallet.

1

View balance and records

Tap Wallet in the menu to see your running balance and full transaction history.

2

Clear cashier wallets

Owners go to Staff, select a cashier, and tap Clear to Owner to transfer their balance.

3

Download statement

Tap Statement in the wallet to generate a PDF of all transactions.

👤

Customers (Credit Accounts)

Section 11
1

Go to Customers

Tap Customers in the menu to see all credit accounts.

2

View balance and history

Tap a customer to see their full charge and payment history, current balance, and contact info.

3

Record a payment

Tap Add Payment, enter the amount, and confirm. The balance updates immediately.

4

Download a bill

Tap Bill to generate a PDF statement to share with the customer.

👥

Staff (Cashiers)

Section 12
1

Tap Staff in the menu

Only the owner can manage staff accounts.

2

Add a cashier

Tap Add Cashier, set a username and password. They can log in immediately.

3

Clear or suspend a cashier

Tap a cashier card to transfer their wallet balance to the owner or suspend their access.

💡

Cashiers only see the Bar register and their own wallet. They cannot access owner settings, reports, or products.

📋

Manager — Bar Expense

Section 13

The Manager role is for recording bar supply expenses — stock purchases, utilities, and other costs.

1

Log in as manager

Managers are created by the owner in the Staff section with job title set to Manager.

2

Open Bar Expense

Tap Bar Expense in the menu to record a new expense with category, amount, and note.

3

Owner reviews in Summary

All manager-logged expenses appear in the owner's Summary report under the Expenses tab.

🎰

Machines Tracker

Section 14

Available on Machines Only and Bar with Machines plans. Track payouts, income, and profit per gaming machine.

1

Create your machines

Tap Machines then the + icon to add each machine with a name.

2

Set a float

Before recording payouts, tap a machine and set the opening float amount for the session.

3

Record payouts and income

Log each payout to players and income loaded into the machine. The app calculates net profit.

4

Export session PDF

Tap the PDF icon to download a full session report for any machine.

🎵

Music Player

Section 15

Built-in YouTube music player — search and queue songs for the bar without leaving the app.

1

Tap Music in the menu

The music player opens. Search YouTube for any song or playlist.

2

Queue tracks

Tap a result to play it. Previous tracks are saved in history so you can replay them.

3

Music keeps playing while you work

Navigate back to the Bar or any other page — music continues in the background.

📊

Summary Reports

Section 16

Owners get a full financial overview — sales, expenses, profits, and cashier breakdowns.

1

Tap Summary

Available to owners only. Shows totals for the current and previous sessions.

2

Filter by date range

Use the date pickers to see data for any custom period.

3

Download PDF

Tap the download icon to export the full summary report as a PDF.

⚙️

Profile & Settings

Section 17
1

Tap Profile

Update your bar name, contact details, and change your password.

2

Change password

Enter your current password, then your new password and confirm it.

3

Language

Switch the app between English and Spanish from the Language option in the menu.

📡

Offline Mode & Sync

Section 18

Bartendaz Pro is a web app backed by Supabase. An internet connection is required for all real-time features.

⚠️

No offline mode. Sales, wallets, and reports all require an active connection. Use a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data connection at your bar.

💡

Install the app as a PWA (Add to Home Screen in your browser) for a native-app feel and faster load times.
